title: Scottish Fire and Rescue Service — AI Governance Deep-Dive Pack
description: The Scottish Fire and Rescue Service is the national fire and rescue service for Scotland, providing prevention, protection, and emergency response across all 32 local authority areas. It is the largest fire and rescue service in the UK by territory covered. This deep-dive pack maps 12 entry points for AI governance, 8 transformation priorities, 6 MCP servers, and 6 non-negotiable red lines anchored in devolved Scottish fire safety legislation.
legislation: Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 / Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 / Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 / DPA 2018 / Equality Act 2010 / Scotland Act 1998 / Civil Contingencies Act 2004
